pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions characterized by smooth, rounded pixel gradients at the edges rather than sharp angularity. Patches on the flank exhibit larger relative spatial area compared to those on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space with moderate and relatively uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude serrated 1D contour visible along the upper neck ridge, though the silhouette is partially interrupted by external subjects.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark-colored avian subjects (likely oxpeckers) are perched along the dorsal ridge and the lateral surface of the upper neck, creating distinct point-source occlusions.
